content.content:
## Organisation overview
Gravity Vault is a chain of indoor rock climbing gyms and describes itself as the first indoor rock climbing franchise. ![](images/logo.png)

Mission statement: the gyms aim to make every visit a positive, memorable climbing experience. They work to be welcoming, diverse, equitable and inclusive to customers and staff alike. Young or old, big or small, beginner or expert, everyone should feel the gym is a second home. The company believes new heights can be reached on the walls and in life, and that people get there best together.

## Main website links
- Home
- Options to Climb
- Locations
- Covid-19 Updates
- About (About Us)
- Franchising
- Contact (Contact Us)
- Careers
- FAQs
- Gift Cards: https://gravityvaultclimbing.com/app/w/v2/?s=1
- Main site: https://www.gravityvault.com/
- Contact page: https://www.gravityvault.com/contact
- Legal and utility pages: Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Site Map
- ![](images/icon-indicator.png)

## Location finder
Visitors can find a gym by picking a state from: California, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, then searching.

## Featured offerings
- **Gift Cards:** Buy online as a present of climbing; recipients redeem them at the gyms. ![](images/img)
- **Waivers:** First-time climbers can begin check-in by completing their waiver online. The gym's location page has more details. Anyone unsure whether they already have an account can phone the gym. ![](images/img)
- **Visiting during Covid-19:** Thanks to the community for helping keep the environment as safe as possible. Current policies are on the Covid-19 page. ![](images/img)
- **Franchising:** As the first indoor rock climbing franchise, the team guides prospective owners through building and running their own Gravity Vault gym, and explains what ownership and the brand involve. ![](images/img)
- A further page image: ![](images/img)

## Locations

### California
- Marin County, CA (locations/marin-county-ca) ![](images/img)

### New Jersey
- Brick, NJ (locations/brick-nj) ![](images/img)
- Chatham, NJ (locations/chatham-nj): The second Gravity Vault to open, with options for newcomers through experienced climbers and over 13,500 sq ft of climbing. ![](images/img)
- Flemington, NJ (locations/flemington-nj): Climbing home of Hunterdon County, with 17,500 sq ft of climbing, a 360-degree boulder and more. ![](images/img)
- Hoboken, NJ (locations/hoboken-nj): 25,000 sq ft of climbing in the Mile Square. ![](images/img)
- Middletown, NJ (locations/middletown-nj): Over 14,000 sq ft of climbing including arêtes, chimneys, overhangs, arches and extensive bouldering. Open 7 days a week. ![](images/img)
- Montclair, NJ (locations/montclair-nj) ![](images/img)
- Upper Saddle River, NJ (locations/upper-saddle-river-nj): Bringing indoor climbing to northern New Jersey since 2005, with over 13,500 sq ft including private rooms suited to birthday parties, lounge seating and a cardio area. ![](images/img)
- Voorhees, NJ (locations/voorhees-nj): Newly open; see the location page for details. ![](images/img)

### New York
- Nassau County, NY: Coming soon. ![](images/img)
- Melville, NY (locations/melville-ny): Over 20,000 sq ft of modern climbing terrain, more than 100 rope stations and extensive bouldering, from highly technical routes to beginner walls suited to parties and corporate events. A metro-quality gym on Long Island, easy to reach from the expressway, with plenty of FREE parking. ![](images/img)
- Poughkeepsie, NY (locations/poughkeepsie-ny): The Hudson Valley's best indoor climbing, with party walls, steep boulder problems and hard lead routes, offering fun and challenge for everyone. Open 7 days a week. ![](images/img)

### Pennsylvania
- Lehigh Valley, PA: Coming soon. ![](images/img)
- Philadelphia, PA: Coming soon. ![](images/img)
- Radnor, PA (locations/radnor-pa): A modern climbing facility serving the Philadelphia/Main Line area. ![](images/img)

## Newsletter and social media
- Newsletter signup is offered.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thegravityvault
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/gravityvault/
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/GravityVault
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/gravity-vault
- Pinterest: https://www.pinterest.com/GravityVault/

## Credits and legal
- © 2021 Gravity Vault
- Website by Lform Design, a New Jersey web design company: http://www.lform.com

I built the site as a single page, `index.html`, in your project folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and the state filter are untested.

**What's on the page:**
- **Header and hero:** a sticky navigation bar with the logo, and a hero section built around the mission. Its buttons go to the location finder and to Gift Cards.
- **Options to Climb:** cards for Gift Cards, Waivers, Visiting during Covid-19 and Franchising.
- **Locations:** a state dropdown (California, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania) that filters the gym list. Each gym links to its page on gravityvault.com, and the Nassau County, Lehigh Valley and Philadelphia entries are tagged "Coming soon".
- **About Us, Franchising and newsletter:** the mission text, a franchising pitch with a contact button, and a newsletter signup form.
- **Footer:** the social links, legal links and the credits line.

**Things to check:**
- **Image:** the brief lists many image placeholders, but `images/` has only one photo (the extensionless file `img`), so I used it once, in the hero. The cards and gym listings have no photos. Add more images to `images/` if you want them.
- **Links:** the brief gives URLs only for Gift Cards, Contact and the main site. Covid-19, Careers, FAQs, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and Site Map all point to the main site homepage, so replace those with the real pages.
- **Newsletter form:** it only shows "Thanks!" and doesn't send the email anywhere.
